title: Staging Zones
about: Moving through different parts of the stage and learning to trust the music instead of one fixed place.
description: This track reflects on how State Arts-In staging was constantly changing from song to song. The ballroom floor, staircase, balcony, and other spaces all became part of the performance, with no single place defining where I belonged. Looking back, that movement feels like a metaphor for growing up: learning to adapt, trust the moment, and find home wherever the next part of the story takes you.

Lyrics: From just one place on the floor.
A mark wasn't painted for every step,
Life was changing while we danced...
Some nights I'd cross the ballroom,
Some nights I'd stay up high.
You learned to trust the music,
Not the place beneath your feet.
Than where the songs would meet.
From one moment to the next,
Finding home where the music goes.
